name: Tharek Blackstone
summary: In Kharanos, Tharek Blackstone keeps dwarven tools flowing to local craftsmen. Beldin Steelgrill at Steelgrill's Depot is his main customer, and Tharek also helps travelers find work around town.

sections.title: A Busy Toolsmith in Kharanos
sections.body: Tharek Blackstone keeps his forge busy in Kharanos, repairing gear and making tools for local workers. His main customer is Beldin Steelgrill, whose mechanostrider depot just outside town needs a steady supply of heavy wrenches, gears, and replacement tools. Tharek hires passing travelers to carry finished crates to the depot, so he can keep up with the work at his forge.

sections.title: A Community Figure
sections.body: Tharek has earned the respect of people across Dun Morogh through his work at the anvil. He holds no formal military title, but people in town turn to him for odd jobs, supply runs, and help coordinating local efforts.

faq.answer: Tharek Blackstone is a dwarven toolsmith in Kharanos, Dun Morogh. He makes and repairs heavy tools for local workers, and hires passing travelers to deliver supplies around the valley.

faq.q: What is his relationship with Beldin Steelgrill?
faq.answer: Beldin Steelgrill runs Steelgrill's Depot just east of Kharanos, where mechanostriders and siege engines are repaired. He is Tharek's main customer, ordering so much ironware that Tharek often hires travelers to deliver finished shipments to the depot.

faq.q: Where can I find Tharek Blackstone?
faq.answer: Tharek Blackstone stands outside near the center of Kharanos in Dun Morogh, within easy walking distance of the local inn and forge.

faq.q: Does Tharek hold any official rank in Ironforge?
faq.answer: Tharek holds no military commission or political office. He is a busy toolsmith who hires newcomers in need of coin to carry supplies for him.

angles.text: For smiths passing through Kharanos, Tharek shows the daily work of a toolsmith, making sturdy wrenches and iron fittings for dwarven machinery.
As a dwarf, you share the working spirit of Dun Morogh: local industry depends on people who keep at the anvil.
